senses.gloss: a. Relating to the case terminations.

__1 Dry ginger. 
__2 Emerald. -a. Relating to सुपर्ण bird or Garuḍa; सौपर्णमस्त्रं प्रतिसंजहार [[R. 16. 80.]]
A particular mixed tribe; चण्डालेन तु सौपाकः चण्डालसमवृत्तिमान् [[Mb. 13. 48. 27.]]

a. 
(-की f.) 
__1 Connected with or relating to sleep. 
__2 Somniferous. 
-कम् A night-attack, an attack on sleeping men; कृते प्रतिकृतं पश्य हतपुत्रा हि पाण्डवाः । सौप्तिके शिबिरं तेषां हतं सनरवाहनम् ॥ [[Mb. 10. 9. 51.]] 
-Comp. 
-पर्वन् n. N. of the tenth parvan or book of the Mahābhārata [Page1708-2] which relates how Aśvatthāman, Kṛtavarman and Kṛpa-the only surviving Kuru warriors-attacked by night the Pāṇḍava-camp and slaughtered thousands of warriors while asleep. 
-वधः the great nocturnal slaughter of Pāṇḍava-camp (above referred to); मार्गो ह्येष नरेन्द्रसौप्तिकवधे पूर्वं कृतो द्रौणिना [[Mk. 3. 11.]]
